packages.name: scan-to-text
packages.description: Read text from a photo, a screenshot or a scanned PDF when there is no text layer. Use when the user sends a picture of a document, a receipt, a contract page or a scan and asks what is in it, or when a PDF comes back with "no text layer".

packages.description: Текст с картинки или скана через системный Vision (macOS): слова с рамками, без установки моделей и без pip
